Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.



Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure — product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements — natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.



This is the defining technical role of the group. The Staff Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model — a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.



Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! 

 



What you'll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

 - Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

 - Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements — solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

 - Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

 - Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution — this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

 - Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

 - Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

 - Set the technical standard for the group — define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around



How to be successful in this role:

 - 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

 - Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base — you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

 - A track record of shipping in stages: you've moved large, structurally complex problems forward incrementally, with each phase standing on its own, without getting ahead of what customers and the product can absorb

 - A history of operating effectively across squads and teams you don't own — alignment built through technical clarity and credibility, not org chart proximity

 - Deep familiarity with enterprise architectural patterns: tenancy models, role-based access control, data isolation, scoped permissions, cross-tenant operations, and access boundary design

 - Strong communication skills — you make complex systems legible to engineering leadership, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders, in writing and in the room

 - Data residency or GovCloud exposure is a plus; the right person ramps on this in a quarter once the core structural problems are in hand

 - Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

title: Staff Product Manager, Data Platform
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



As the Staff Product Manager, Data Platform at Vanta, you will be responsible for product strategy and direction for Vanta’s data platform. You’ll sit between the core platform and feature teams, driving the roadmap for transforming how we fetch, store, and use data from customers and 3rd parties at scale. This platform directly enables customer and business outcomes, and backs Vanta’s products and experiences. This is a highly impactful, technical role at the center of how Vanta works and meets customer needs at real scale. Vanta manages data from over 16,000 customers and is rapidly scaling daily.



You’ll be part of Vanta’s Automation group, which owns how customers discover and connect to other platforms through integrations, use that data to power product experiences and tests, drive customers toward compliance-related security outcomes, and ultimately generate the evidence required for audit. You aren’t building Vanta’s service delivery platform - you’re building the engine that powers compliance and monitoring outcomes. Your team will be Foundations, which has wide scope and depth, and you’ll be the sole PM to support the data platform.



What you’ll do as Staff Product Manager, Data Platform at Vanta:

 - Own the impactful Data Platform roadmap, pairing closely with engineering counterparts to plan durable platform investments that serve our customers and products built on top of customer data

 - Collaborate closely with other product teams to understand what platform investments they need to be successful, get ahead of their roadmaps, and create a plan that balances short and long term needs to support customer outcomes.

 - Directly drive the Vanta data platform strategy and support GRC strategies, creating clarity on sequencing and support as you build the platform and empower teams to use it.

 - Guide the hard tradeoffs between feature development and platform stability, using clarity and empathy to provide clean direction to other teams.

 - Enable and evangelize for the data platform, working with other teams to help encourage platform contribution and usage

 - Work directly with customers to understand unique platform requirements and opportunities including shipping features directly to support an outcome.

 - Look ahead 12-18 months to build a platform that scales with Vanta, including building toward AI native uses and agent operations.

 - Create and measure key metrics and results for platform investments, and own key outcomes around scalability, feature enablement, and queryability.

 - Support an existing team of engineers and tech leads focused on the data platform



How to be successful in this role:

 - Have 6+ years supporting platform teams, with a preference for data platforms or data products. You’ve built and scaled data platforms before, and know how to make platform roadmaps successful.

 - Come having built 0->1 platforms. You’re not just comfortable with mature data platforms, but have experience building new systems over long time horizons with rich communication along the way.

 - Balance independence and strong communication. You don’t need someone to tell you what to build next, are comfortable learning fast and driving priority within your team, and proactively loop in engineering, other PMs, and your stakeholders before decisions land.

 - Have strong frameworks to build complex platforms with clear sequencing, goals, and progress tracking. You know how to tell the unique story of platform work internally and externally.

 - Be intensely curious and collaborative, naturally leaning into pairing with other teams to understand their platform needs, translate them into common requirements, and enable them as they develop new features and products. You’ve earned the trust of other teams and engineers with a track record of clear and unemotional decision making.

 - Be technically sharp with data platform topics. You need to have solid general knowledge of topics like data push/pull, databases and storage, querying, and APIs. You’re able to work seamlessly with engineers on complex topics while translating these clearly to stakeholders.

 - Be outcome oriented, keeping business and customer goals front and center as you build platform, laddering your efforts up to demonstrable impacts.

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. #LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

description:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

You'll help build Confluent Cloud's AI capabilities — the layer that lets customers bring AI  and AI agents capabilities directly to their real-time data. Instead of moving data out to a separate system to run inference or build an agent, our customers do it in place, on streaming data, as part of the same platform they already use to move and process events at scale.

As an engineer, you'll own delivery of significant pieces of this product — not just writing code, but deciding how a capability should work across the services that make it up. The interesting problems here rarely live in one place: shipping something like inference-on-streaming-data or an AI agent that reacts to live events touches several systems at once — the user-facing API, the services that manage model and agent lifecycle, the control plane that schedules and runs the work, and the serving layer that actually executes inference. You'll be expected to reason across those boundaries, make sound design calls, and get engineers inside and outside the team aligned on the approach.




WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 - Design and build the backend services (primarily Go, Java, and Python) that run AI and model inference on real-time data.

 - Own features end to end — drafting the design, aligning stakeholders inside and outside the team, and driving the decision to a conclusion.

 - Make the technical calls on systems that span teams: model lifecycle, inference routing, and agent execution.

 - Own the quality of what you ship — code, test coverage, documentation, operability, and rollout safety. This is production infrastructure serving live inference, so reliability isn't an afterthought.

 - Make the engineers around you better through code review, design feedback, and being someone the team trusts with ambiguous, cross-cutting work.

 - Participate in on-call for the services your team owns, and help keep the team's processes and rituals healthy.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

 -  10+ years of significant experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems or cloud-native backend infrastructure in production

 - .Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes and distributed-systems patterns (control loops, API servers, high-scale control planes), plus the fundamentals — containerization, networking, resource isolation.

 - Proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, or Python, and the willingness to work across all three.

 - A track record of leading cross-team technical work: turning ambiguous requirements into designs others can rally behind.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a design doc that aligns people who don't report to you.




WHAT GIVES YOU AN EDGE:

 - Exposure to model serving, LLM/agent infrastructure, or streaming data systems.
   
   - You don't need a background in ML research or model training — this role is about building and operating the platform that serves AI reliably at scale, not inventing the models.




READY TO BUILD WHAT'S NEXT? LET’S GET IN MOTION.







COME AS YOU ARE

Belonging isn’t a perk here. It’s the baseline. We work across time zones and backgrounds, knowing the best ideas come from different perspectives. And we make space for everyone to lead, grow, and challenge what’s possible.

title: Staff Product Manager, Real Time Data Analytics Platform
description:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Today, enterprises stitch together separate systems for streaming, analytics, and serving. Each of these systems come with its own latency, cost, and operational overhead. The next evolution of Confluent's platform collapses that complexity by continuously materializing streaming data into fast, queryable state that serves real-time analytics, operational applications, and downstream intelligent systems from a single foundation.



As a Staff Product Manager, you'll own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the core streaming analytics engine underlying Confluent's real-time data platform. This system sits at the intersection of stream processing, real-time analytical databases, and modern serving infrastructure, continuously transforming data in motion into low-latency, queryable materialized views that power AI agents, dashboards, operational queries, and event-driven applications. You'll own the engine: the storage, materialization, query layer, and performance, while partnering with peer product managers who own the downstream product experiences built on top of it.



This is a foundational, high-leverage role. You'll define a new product category that brings together concepts from streaming analytics, real-time OLAP, materialized views, and modern database systems into a cloud-native, streaming-first architecture. You'll partner directly with engineering, design, and senior leadership to bring this to market and position Confluent as a compelling alternative to standalone real-time analytical databases.




WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 - Own the product strategy for Confluent's streaming analytics engine: storage, materialization, query serving, performance, and developer experience.

 - Develop competitive strategy against established real-time analytical databases, articulating Confluent's differentiated value as a streaming-native alternative.

 - Drive key architectural and product tradeoffs across consistency, latency, query performance, cost, and developer ergonomics.

 - Partner deeply with engineering to navigate the technical complexity of building a new cloud-native data system at scale.

 - Collaborate with peer product managers who own downstream experiences including AI, context delivery, and application integration, to ensure the engine meets the needs of the products built on it.

 - Work with customers and design partners to validate use cases across real-time analytics, operational applications, and AI, shaping the developer experience and refining go-to-market positioning.

 - Collaborate with Confluent's broader product and platform teams to ensure tight integration with Kafka, Flink, and Confluent Cloud.

 - Define success metrics, cost models, and pricing strategy for a new product area.

 - Influence Confluent's company-wide platform strategy through executive-level communication and cross-functional leadership.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

 - 8+ years of experience in product management or related technical roles.

 - 5+ years of experience taking technical infrastructure or data products from conception to launch.

 - Deep familiarity with real-time analytics, database internals, or streaming data platform architecture, either through product management or hands-on engineering.

 - Experience defining and launching products in the data infrastructure, analytics database, or stream processing space.

 - Strong technical judgment, comfortable navigating tradeoffs in distributed systems, storage engines, query performance, and cost optimization.

 - Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives with executive-level visibility and communicating technical strategy to senior leadership.




WHAT GIVES YOU AN EDGE:

 - Engineering background in analytical databases, stream processing, or distributed storage systems.

 - Experience with real-time OLAP engines (e.g., ClickHouse, Apache Druid, StarRocks, Apache Pinot) as a builder, product manager, or power user.

title: Product Design Manager
description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Senior Staff Design Manager to support our mission.

This role is based in New York or San Francisco and open to those who are able to be in-office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.



About the Team

The Design team at Patreon is responsible for the full consumer experience across our creator and fan products. The team spans product design and content design, working across Patreon's core surfaces: memberships, community, live video, and direct sales. Designers here are embedded in cross-functional teams alongside product, engineering, and data, and are expected to drive outcomes, not just deliver assets.

At Patreon, design is fundamental to how we build and how we think about the product. This team reflects that: high craft standards, close partnership with product leadership, and a genuine curiosity about how AI can raise the bar for what we ship



About the Role

As Senior Staff Design Manager, you'll lead a team of 6-7 product designers alongside another senior design manager, and represent the design leadership bench at Patreon.

You'll lead by example in the craft, not just through management: staying close to the work in Figma, prototyping, or production code, while partnering across product and engineering to shape the next chapter of design at Patreon. 

You'll also be a strong external voice for the design team, helping build Patreon's reputation as a place where great designers want to work.



What you’ll need:

 - You've shipped distinctive consumer software where design was central to the product's market position, not just polish on a working thing, across a range of products or surfaces rather than a single hero project

 - You lead by example in the craft, whether in Figma, prototyping, or production code

 - You're a proven manager with success across different sizes and shapes of design teams, and you've operated across different configurations (startup, scale, public) rather than running one playbook

 - You have real AI fluency: you use tools daily and have driven measurable, team-wide transformation in velocity, quality, or scope

 - You have a track record of building and holding high talent density: top designers choose to work for you and stay, and the people you've hired and developed have gone on to become strong leaders themselves

 - You're a strategic thought partner across functions, oriented toward shared outcomes rather than territory

 - You're a strong external voice for your team's work, brand, and craft



We hire talented and passionate people from different backgrounds because workplace diversity and inclusion is critical to our ability to serve creators worldwide. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t match with every bullet point outlined above, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re a creator at heart, are energized by our mission, and share our company values, we’d love to hear from you.



About Patreon

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our Patronauts:

 - Put Creators First | They’re the reason we’re here. When creators win, we win.

 - Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.

 - Make it Happen | We don’t quit. We learn and deliver.

 - Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.



Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please let us know via email at accommodations@patreon.



Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, healthcare, flexible time off, company holidays and recharge days, commuter benefits, lifestyle stipends, learning and development stipends, patronage, parental leave, and 401k plan with matching.



Patreon operates under a hybrid work model, where employees based in office locations are expected to come into the office two days per week, excluding sick time and paid leave. The goal of this policy is to be  intentional about the in-person time we spend together to strengthen the feeling of community at Patreon. Candidates hired into remote-eligible roles are not expected to meet the same requirements.



At Patreon, we believe in fair and transparent pay. In compliance with New York and California pay transparency laws, we are sharing the expected salary range for this role.



The posted salary range is dependent on the location and the level. This range may encompass multiple levels within the role’s job family. The final offer will be based on candidate’s experience, skills, competencies, and geographic location, aligning with the appropriate job level within Patreon’s leveling framework. For remote employees located outside CA and NY, salary may vary based on location and local market conditions.



Patreon reserves the right to modify or update compensation and benefits at any time.

description:

As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.



Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.




THE ROLE:

Airbyte is looking for an Engineering Manager, Platform to lead the team responsible for the infrastructure, tooling, and engineering systems that power Airbyte Cloud, Airbyte Flex, and Airbyte Agents.



As an Engineering Manager on the Platform team, you'll lead the engineers responsible for cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and the internal tooling that powers engineering velocity across the company. Your work directly shapes both how fast engineers ship and how customers experience Airbyte. This isn't a keep-the-lights-on role. You'll make real tradeoffs between engineering velocity, customer-facing reliability, and long-term architecture every week, and you'll help define how AI transforms the way we build and operate software.



This role combines people leadership, technical strategy, operational excellence, and platform thinking. You'll help define how engineering works at Airbyte - not just what we build.

 - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Platform Engineers, Fullstack Engineers, and SREs. Recruit engineers who understand that infrastructure decisions are product decisions.

 - Invest in and drive adoption of AI-powered workflows for debugging, release validation, infrastructure management, and developer productivity, moving past experimentation into real operational leverage.

 - Lead incident response, run blameless postmortems, and ensure systemic fixes follow every outage. Continuously reduce operational toil through automation.

 - Build leverage: a week-long task this year should take ten minutes next year.

 


SUCCESS METRICS:

 - Engineers deploy with confidence and ship faster quarter over quarter.

 - Platform reliability improves as measured by customer-facing SLAs, not just internal dashboards.

 - Operational toil decreases through automation, not heroics.

 - Incidents are detected faster, resolved faster, and the same failure doesn't happen twice.

 - Your team is engaged, growing, and building careers they're proud of.

 - Excellent communication skills. You can translate platform strategy into language that product, design, and business leaders understand.

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows or agentic software development.

 - Experience building internal developer platforms.

 - Familiarity with Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and cloud-native infrastructure.

 - Experience with data infrastructure, ETL/ELT, or large-scale distributed systems.

 - Experience contributing to open-source engineering organizations.

 - Familiarity with Airbyte, connector ecosystems, or developer tooling platforms.

 


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:

Platform Engineering is the force multiplier for every engineering team at Airbyte.



Your mission is to build the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that enable engineers to move faster while making our platform more reliable, secure, and scalable. Success means every deployment becomes safer, every incident becomes easier to resolve, every engineer becomes more productive, and AI becomes a natural part of how software is built.



The best platform teams are invisible—they make everyone else dramatically more effective. That's the team you'll build.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Agent Infrastructure
description:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.



We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.



Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.







THE ROLE:

Airbyte is building the runtime that powers production-grade AI agents.



This is not an ML research or prompt engineering role. We’re looking for an experienced backend or platform engineer who has built complex production systems and has also worked hands-on with AI agents, orchestration, retrieval, or LLM-powered applications.



Our AI Runtime sits between language models and the enterprise systems agents need to understand and act on. It is responsible for assembling the right context, identifying entities across systems, selecting tools and connectors, coordinating execution, validating evidence, enforcing permissions, and handling failures safely.



A user may ask something simple like:

 - “Investigate this customer and tell me what changed.”

Behind that request, the runtime may need to identify the customer across multiple systems, retrieve fresh data, determine which tools to call, coordinate multiple steps, validate the result, and return an answer with evidence the user can trust.



That infrastructure is what you’ll help build.



We’re still early. The architecture is taking shape, but there is significant room to influence how the runtime is designed, how developers interact with it, and how we make agentic systems reliable in production.






WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Build the Runtime

 - Design and implement the orchestration layer that turns natural-language intent into reliable, multi-step execution.

 - Build systems for routing, state management, retries, failure handling, and long-running agent workflows.

 - Develop systems for entity resolution, context assembly, connector orchestration, and evidence retrieval.

 - Build reusable Skills that encapsulate business workflows and domain-specific capabilities.

 - Coordinate connectors, APIs, tools, deterministic logic, retrieval systems, and multiple language models.



Build Reliable AI Infrastructure

 - Design systems that retrieve and assemble the right enterprise context at runtime.

 - Build evidence-backed reasoning with citations and traceability that users can inspect and verify.

 - Implement permission models, freshness validation, and action policies for production environments.

 - Build evaluation, replay, observability, and debugging systems that help us understand why agents succeed or fail.

 - Improve the reliability of systems where model outputs may be probabilistic, but execution cannot be.



Own Products End to End

 - Take ambiguous product ideas from prototype through production.

 - Own features across architecture, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

 - Work directly with Product, Design, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and customers to understand real-world problems.

 - Write high-leverage code that creates reusable infrastructure for future product areas.

 - Experiment with new agent architectures while maintaining production-grade reliability.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

You may be a strong fit if you are fundamentally a backend or platform engineer who has also spent meaningful time building production AI systems.

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing distributed systems.

 - Experience building complex systems involving APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency, queues, state, retries, or distributed execution.

 - Hands-on experience building production applications using LLMs, agents, RAG, tool calling, MCP, or similar technologies.

 - Experience with orchestration systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or infrastructure products.

 - Strong system design skills and the ability to reason about reliability, scale, observability, and failure modes.

 - Ability to move quickly from prototype to production without sacrificing engineering quality.

 - Strong product instincts and comfort operating in ambiguous, 0-to-1 environments.

 - Exceptional written communication skills.

 - A strong bias toward ownership and shipping.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building agent infrastructure, agent platforms, or evaluation systems.

 - Familiarity with orchestration technologies such as LangGraph, Temporal, MCP, or similar.

 - Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, search infrastructure, or knowledge graphs.

 - Experience building developer tools or platform infrastructure.

 - Experience with data infrastructure such as Kafka, Iceberg, Postgres, Spark, or modern data warehouses.

 - Experience working on early-stage products where you helped define architecture and technical direction.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success is not measured by the sophistication of the prompts. It is measured by whether the runtime becomes more reliable, observable, and trustworthy over time.

You’ll build systems that:

 - Assemble the right context and choose the correct connectors, tools, and Skills.

 - Execute multi-step workflows reliably.

 - Recover gracefully when something fails.

 - Produce evidence-backed answers with citations and traceability.

 - Enforce permissions, freshness guarantees, and action policies.

 - Learn from failures through replay, evaluation, and observability.

 - Allow users to focus on outcomes rather than coordinating individual tools themselves.

As the runtime evolves, developers and users should need to think less about the underlying tools and more about what they want to accomplish. The runtime should handle the complexity underneath.






WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

AI agents work impressively in demos. Making them reliable in production is much harder.

The difficult problems are often not the model itself. They are retrieving the right context, connecting to real enterprise systems, maintaining permissions, coordinating multiple actions, recovering from failures, and determining whether an answer can actually be trusted.

Airbyte already connects to hundreds of business systems. We’re building the runtime that allows agents to use that infrastructure intelligently and safely.

If we succeed, developers will not need to rebuild orchestration, retrieval, permissions, evaluation, and enterprise connectivity every time they build a new agent.

title: Staff Systems Software Engineer
description:
Staff Systems Software Engineer

Remote US & Canada



About this role

Most engineering roles at Thatgamecompany ship features to players. This one ships velocity and quality to engineers. Cloud, Gameplay Backend, and Cross-Platform Backend build the services and features the game runs on; you build the systems that prove that work is correct, fast, and ready — before it reaches players. You will build the systems that prove the gameplay feature works — at scale, on every device, on every commit — and the infrastructure that lets a hundred engineers find that out in minutes instead of days. If it runs in production, another team owns it. If it exists to test, measure, or accelerate what those teams build — test harnesses, load/chaos infrastructure, device labs, build/GPU clusters — you own it. Your output is the studio's velocity and the game's quality floor.



On any given day, you might:

Prove correctness and quality before players find the bugs

 - Build and own the studio's functional test automation framework — runner, fixtures, game-state harness, reporting — plus coverage instrumentation that makes untested systems visible

 - Build regression analysis tooling that separates real regressions from noise and attributes them to a commit automatically

 - Improve test suite speed/trust via flake detection, quarantine, parallel sharding, deterministic replay



Find the breaking point on purpose

 - Design load/stress testing systems modeling realistic player behavior, capable of driving launch-scale synthetic traffic against pre-production

 - Build chaos testing capability — fault injection, latency/partition simulation, dependency failure — run safely against real infrastructure

 - Run disaster recovery exercises, measure actual RTO/RPO vs. stated targets, and turn findings into permanent regression tests



Prove quality on real devices

 - Build app quality testing automation — frame time, memory, thermal, battery, cold-start captured automatically and gated in CI

 - Own the device compatibility lab, orchestration, and certification matrix so device support is verified every commit, not the week before ship



Own the infrastructure engineers build on

 - Build/operate on-prem build clusters (distributed compilation, caching, artifacts) and on-prem GPU clusters (scheduling, multi-tenancy, utilization), backing buy-vs-build with real data

 - Design cross-platform developer tools — including AI-assisted tooling (agents, skills, MCP servers) — that reduce toil across Cloud, Backend, and Client Engineering



Make it land

 - Define, instrument, and publish developer velocity/quality metrics (build time, test cycle time, flake rate, escaped defect rate, MTTR) and use them to prioritize your roadmap

 - Drive adoption across teams that don't report to you

 - Mentor engineers in testing strategy, performance analysis, systems thinking

 - Raise the bar through code review, documentation, reducing bus factor



We expect you to

 - Be a passionate gamer who puts players first

 - Treat developer experience as a product — users, adoption curves, a quality bar — not internal plumbing

 - Operate at Staff level: set technical direction studio-wide, influence without authority

 - Be relentless about systems that prevent problems, not just report them

 - Embrace experimentation for ambiguous, complex problems

 - Communicate trade-offs clearly across distributed teams



Required Skills

 - Languages: Python, Golang, C/C++, Jenkins Groovy; Linux shell scripting; fluent English

 - Testing & Quality Systems: Test framework design; load/stress tooling (k6, Locust, Gatling, JMeter); fault injection/chaos engineering; coverage instrumentation; flake detection

 - Performance & Analysis: CPU/GPU/memory/I/O profiling; statistical analysis of noisy benchmarks; regression detection and commit attribution; observability

 - Build & CI at Scale: Jenkins/GitLab CI/CD; Make/CMake; GCC/Clang; distributed build systems/caching; Git/GitLab and Perforce (large-binary workflows)

 - Infrastructure: Linux/macOS administration; bare-metal/on-prem cluster ops; Docker/Podman; Kubernetes; Terraform/OpenTofu; hardware capacity planning

 - Systems Fundamentals: Distributed systems failure modes; TCP/IP and UDP; resilience patterns; disaster recovery planning and execution



Preferred Skills

Mobile device farm operation, Android/iOS build and profiling toolchains, GPU cluster scheduling (Slurm, K8s device plugins, MIG), game engine internals/engine-level test automation, deterministic simulation/replay testing, live service game experience (or SaaS/PaaS/XaaS equivalent), Windows administration, Ansible, TypeScript/Java/Kotlin/Swift, hybrid/multi-cloud management

description:

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

 - Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

 - Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

 - Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Account Management team is part of the Sales Team at Gorgias. The focus of our team is driving growth in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) through renewals, cross-selling and upselling to our existing customer base. In this critical and highly cross-functional role, you will be joining a team of 5 Account Managers that support our largest customers and your skills will be instrumental in driving revenue.

Working closely with your Customer Success Managers (CSMs), you will be responsible for driving growth, retention, and influence across a portfolio of our largest global customers; organizations that shape the industries we serve. The scope is broad, the expectations are high, and the impact is direct: your ability to understand complex business environments and deliver tailored solutions will define our success in these regions.

 - Develop Strategic Account Plans: Collaborate with the CSM to create tailored plans for each account, leveraging insights to maximize customer value and align with their business objectives.

 - Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with CS, Product and Legal to deliver seamless customer experiences and address complex challenges effectively.

 - Relationship Builder: Skilled at engaging and influencing C-level executives, fostering trust and long-term partnerships.

 - Data-Driven: Experienced in reviewing and interpreting data trends, using insights to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and present actionable solutions to clients.

 - Strategic Problem Solver: Able to diagnose customer pain points and develop tailored solutions that drive meaningful outcomes.

 - Excellent Communicator: Strong verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating technical concepts into business value.

 - Results-Oriented: Focused on achieving and surpassing growth and retention goals.

 - Highly Organized: Adept at managing multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.



We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.



Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.




THE ROLE:

Airbyte is seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our growing sales organization. In this role, you will own a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts and be responsible for generating, progressing, and closing new business across Airbyte’s product offerings.



You will work a mix of qualified inbound opportunities and strategically selected target accounts, while building relationships and creating demand across your territory. You will primarily engage with CTO, CIO, data, and engineering organizations, working with stakeholders ranging from data engineers and architects to senior business and technology executives.



A successful candidate will be comfortable navigating complex technical environments, leading multi-stakeholder sales processes, and connecting technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes. A foundational understanding of cloud infrastructure, the modern data stack, APIs, data integration, and database replication is strongly preferred. Candidates with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts will also be considered.



This is a new-business-focused role. Success will be driven by landing strategic customers, establishing Airbyte within an initial use case, and creating a clear path toward broader adoption across the organization. You will join a fast-growing company with a strong product-led motion, a highly technical customer base, and a significant market opportunity.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from account development and discovery through technical evaluation, proposal, negotiation, procurement, and closed-won.

 - Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through a combination of qualified inbound opportunities, targeted outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and strategic account development.

 - Develop trusted relationships across technical, business, and executive stakeholders within enterprise accounts.

 - Lead effective discovery to uncover customer challenges, business priorities, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

 - Apply value-selling principles and Airbyte’s sales methodology, including Command of the Message and MEDDPICC, to quantify customer pain, establish urgency, differentiate Airbyte, and maintain control of the sales process.

 - Build clear and compelling business cases that connect Airbyte’s technical capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Engineering to scope, manage, and successfully complete technical evaluations and proofs of value.

 - Create account strategies that support both initial adoption and long-term expansion.

 - Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline, MEDDPICC, and forecast information.

 - Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly bookings targets.

 - Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Engineering, Customer Success, and other internal teams to share market feedback, competitive intelligence, customer requirements, and product opportunities.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 3-5+ years of B2B sales experience within SaaS, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or data technology, including at least 1-2+ years selling into enterprise accounts.

 - A demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding quota in a new-business sales role.

 - Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

 - Experience using structured enterprise sales methodologies such as Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, and value-based selling.

 - A proven ability to uncover and quantify business pain, build compelling value propositions, establish urgency, and navigate enterprise decision-making processes.

 - Confidence engaging both technical practitioners and executive buyers.

 - The ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value.

 - Strong prospecting, discovery, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.

 - Excellent organization, pipeline management, and forecasting discipline.

 - Direct experience with data infrastructure, cloud platforms, data integration, or the modern data stack is strongly preferred.

 - A proactive, curious, accountable, and collaborative working style.

 - The ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

 


LOCATION:

 - Remote in Central and East Coast Timezones




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

 - Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually

 - Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement

title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build lasting businesses, including paid and free memberships, community chats, live experiences, and one-time purchases.

Ultimately, our goal is simple: fund the creative class. We’re leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon’s inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today

We’re continuing to invest in building the best creator platform and team in the creator economy. We’re looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to help advance that mission.

This role is based in New York or San Francisco and is open to candidates who can work in-office two days per week under our hybrid model.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth Marketing team builds demand for Patreon and turns audience interest into durable relationships between fans and creators. Our remit spans Paid Media, Marketing Partnerships, SEO, and Lifecycle, with close partnership across Product, Product Marketing, Data, Engineering, Brand, Creative, Policy, Trust & Safety, and other teams.

Lifecycle is a critical growth capability at Patreon. Today, the opportunity extends well beyond individual email campaigns: we need a connected strategy for how Patreon engages both fans and creators across their journeys, a strong operating model for the channel, and the data and marketing technology foundation to deliver relevant experiences at scale. The immediate priority is building a more intentional fan lifecycle program while continuing to support and strengthen creator communications.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to serve as the strategic and operational owner of Patreon’s lifecycle program across both fan and creator audiences. The initial priority will be defining and building the fan lifecycle, while also owning the strategy, governance, and execution of creator lifecycle communications. This is a high-impact senior individual contributor role for someone who can set the vision, build the systems, align collaborators, and remain close enough to execution to ensure the work ships with quality.

You’ll define how Patreon engages fans from their first interaction through activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and re-engagement—helping fans discover more of what they love and deepen their relationships with creators. You’ll also shape how Patreon communicates with creators across onboarding, activation, growth, engagement, retention, product adoption, and critical operational moments, partnering with our Creator Success teams along the way.

This role also owns the operating and technical foundation that makes lifecycle effective: audience strategy, journey architecture, measurement, experimentation, channel governance, deliverability, localization, data quality, and the marketing technology roadmap. You’ll be the senior lifecycle expert for the company and a trusted partner to leaders across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Data.

This is not an advisory-only role. You’ll translate strategy into an executable roadmap, directly build and launch priority programs, establish repeatable processes, and create the foundation for a team as the function scales.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the lifecycle strategy and roadmap end to end. Define the audience framework, lifecycle moments, journey architecture, channel strategy, orchestration approach, personalization model, and prioritized use cases that guide Patreon’s lifecycle investment.

 - Champion both sides of Patreon’s ecosystem. Develop a deep understanding of fan and creator motivations and behavior, identify the highest-impact opportunities across both lifecycle journeys, and ensure programs strengthen the relationship among fans, creators, and Patreon. Initially, focus the greatest investment on building the fan lifecycle while maintaining thoughtful, effective creator communications.

 - Build and execute multi-channel programs. Personally design, write, build, QA, launch, and optimize high-priority campaigns and automated journeys in Braze across lifecycle touchpoints.

 - Lead lifecycle’s marketing technology agenda. Assess the current stack, define the roadmap for Braze and adjacent capabilities, improve platform configuration, shape integration and data requirements, manage vendor relationships, and build business cases for priority investments.

 - Own audience and data quality. Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, Product, Trust & Safety, and Policy to define source-of-truth attributes, improve data freshness, establish durable suppression logic, and ensure targeting and personalization are accurate and safe.

 - Create the lifecycle operating model. Establish a clear intake, prioritization, planning, build, localization, QA, approval, launch, and post-launch process. Maintain the lifecycle calendar, make tradeoffs visible, and ensure urgent requests do not displace strategic work without deliberate prioritization.

 - Protect channel health and user trust. Own deliverability, frequency management, audience overlap, consent and unsubscribe requirements, compliance readiness, high-risk send safeguards, and incident-response standards.

 - Develop the measurement and experimentation system. Define KPIs tied to engagement, conversion, retention, and downstream creator value; build or commission dashboards; design rigorous tests; synthesize results; and turn learnings into program improvements.

 - Lead cross-functional delivery. Bring the right partners together, clarify decision rights and ownership, surface dependencies early, and drive complex initiatives from ambiguous problem through launch and measurement.

 - Raise the bar for lifecycle across Patreon. Serve as the company’s expert on when and how to use lifecycle channels, create self-serve guidance and reusable systems, coach collaborators, and influence roadmaps without relying on formal authority.

 - Build for scale. Document key decisions, architecture, processes, risks, and learnings; improve team capabilities; and help define future roles and resourcing as the lifecycle function grows.

 - Use AI thoughtfully. Apply AI to accelerate journey design, audience development, QA, analysis, and workflow automation while maintaining strong judgment and appropriate safeguards.


ABOUT YOU

 - You care deeply about Patreon’s mission and values. You’re inspired by our goal to fund the creative class and motivated to put creators first, build with craft, make it happen, and win together.

 - You’ve built and owned a lifecycle program—not just individual campaigns. You’ve created strategy, operating rhythms, journey architecture, measurement, and technical foundations in an ambiguous or evolving environment.

 - You combine strategy with hands-on execution. You can establish a multi-year vision and investment roadmap, then open Braze and build the journey, troubleshoot the audience, review the copy, and get the program live.

 - You’re a Braze power user with strong marketing technology judgment. You understand canvases, segmentation, triggers, personalization, experimentation, channel configuration, and platform governance. Experience with Iterable and platform migrations is a plus.

 - You’re technically fluent. You can partner credibly with Engineering and Data teams on event taxonomies, identity and profile architecture, integrations, APIs, data pipelines, source-of-truth fields, freshness, and suppression logic. SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.

 - You know how to turn data into decisions. You define success metrics, evaluate performance independently, identify meaningful patterns, and make clear recommendations without waiting for perfect information.

 - You understand fans, creators, communities, and two-sided ecosystems. You’re energized by the challenge of serving distinct but interconnected audiences—helping fans deepen their engagement while enabling creators to activate, grow, and retain their communities. Experience at a creator platform, marketplace, subscription, media, or community business is a strong plus.

 - You exercise strong independent judgment. You’re comfortable making consequential decisions about prioritization, audience risk, channel health, and launch readiness—and willing to pause or redirect work when the user or business risk is too high.

 - You lead complex work across teams. You can align senior stakeholders, translate between technical and non-technical audiences, resolve ambiguity, and influence Marketing, Product, Data, Engineering, Creative, and operational partners without formal authority.

 - You build with craft and improve systems. You have a high bar for copy, targeting, user experience, and operational quality, while knowing when to move quickly. You replace fragile one-off work with repeatable processes and scalable capabilities.

 - You make others better. You give and receive direct feedback, coach teammates and partners, share context generously, and help create an inclusive, high-performing environment. You’re excited to help build and eventually lead a growing lifecycle function.

 - You bring substantial lifecycle experience. You have 8+ years in lifecycle, CRM, retention, growth, or a related field, including experience owning complex programs at meaningful scale. Equivalent experience that demonstrates the capabilities above is welcome.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, Patreon has:

 - A clear, prioritized lifecycle strategy and roadmap spanning fan and creator audiences, aligned to company goals and sequenced around the initial fan opportunity

 - A shared lifecycle operating model with explicit intake, ownership, approvals, service levels, and launch standards across fan and creator communications

 - High-impact fan journeys live and improving across onboarding, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and re-engagement, alongside a clear strategy and stronger execution for creator lifecycle communications

 - Reliable measurement and a disciplined experimentation cadence tied to business outcomes

 - A documented marketing technology and data roadmap, with critical targeting, freshness, suppression, and platform risks actively addressed

 - Stronger lifecycle partnership across Marketing, Product, Data, Engineering, and other teams

 - A scalable foundation for adding channels, use cases, and future team members without compromising user trust or execution quality


ABOUT PATREON

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our people:

 - Put Creators First | They’re the reason we’re here. When creators win, we win.

 - Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.

 - Make it Happen | We don’t quit. We learn and deliver.

 - Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.

Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please contact accommodations@patreon.com.

Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, healthcare, flexible time off, company holidays and recharge days, commuter benefits, lifestyle stipends, learning and development stipends, patronage, parental leave, and 401k plan with matching.

Patreon operates under a hybrid work model. Employees based in office locations are expected to come into the office two days per week, excluding sick time and paid leave. The goal is to be intentional about in-person time and strengthen our sense of community. Candidates hired into remote-eligible roles are not expected to meet the same requirements.

At Patreon, we believe in fair and transparent pay. In compliance with New York and California pay transparency laws, we are sharing the expected salary range for this role.

The posted salary range is dependent on the location and the level. This range may encompass multiple levels within the role’s job family. title: Contract | Senior UI Artist (MARVEL SNAP)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Second Dinner is an independent game development studio that is here to make the most fun games in the world. Not super fun games. Not SUPER DUPER fun games. We mean the MOST fun games. And for our first game, MARVEL SNAP, we’re partnering with Marvel. That’s right, we get to play in the Marvel Universe!!



As a remote-first company, we want the most talented teammates wherever they call home. While our headquarters is in Irvine, California, most of our team is fully remote! We strongly believe a diverse team with varied perspectives makes us a better company, and in turn, will help us make better games. If you can bring something new to the table and expand our point of view, that's a huge upside, and we’d love to meet you!




OUR ART TEAM

At Second Dinner, the Art Team helps define the visual identity of our games and is responsible for creating a cohesive, polished, and memorable player experience.
We believe great game art comes from a combination of strong fundamentals, thoughtful collaboration, rapid iteration, and an obsessive attention to detail. As Game Artisans, we’re constantly creating, refining, experimenting, and raising the bar for what our games can look and feel like.


We work closely with virtually every discipline across the studio, including Design, Engineering, Production, Product, Data, Marketing, and Sound, to create experiences that are both visually compelling and intuitive for players.




YOUR ROLE

As a Senior UI Artist, you will help define and elevate the visual language of MARVEL SNAP across the game's interface and player experience. You’ll own UI art from early exploration through final implementation, translating gameplay and UX requirements into polished, intuitive, and expressive visual experiences. 

You’ll work closely with UX Designers, Game Designers, Engineers, Product, and the Art Director to solve complex problems through clear visual design. This is a hands-on senior role. We’re looking for someone who can independently take ambiguous problems, develop strong visual solutions, communicate their thinking, and drive those solutions through iteration and implementation. You’ll also help establish and maintain UI visual standards, mentor other artists through feedback and collaboration, and contribute to the continued evolution of MARVEL SNAP’s visual identity.



This is a 6-month contract role to start (with possible extension), but if it’s a great mutual fit, it could evolve into a full-time position.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the visual design and execution of UI experiences from concept through final, game-ready implementation.

 - Create high-quality UI assets including screens, panels, buttons, icons, badges, backgrounds, decorative elements, effects, and other 2D graphic assets.

 - Translate UX flows and gameplay requirements into clear, intuitive, and visually compelling UI solutions.

 - Develop visual explorations, high-fidelity comps, prototypes, and style guides that communicate design intent.

 - Collaborate closely with UX Designers, Game Designers, Engineers, Producers, and other artists to solve UI and player-experience challenges.

 - Establish and maintain cohesive visual standards across UI features and systems.

 - Create and refine iconography, typography, layout, color, hierarchy, and other visual-design systems.

 - Design UI interactions and visual states, including transitions, feedback, emphasis, and other moments that make the interface feel responsive and alive.

 - Implement UI art directly in the game engine and work with Engineers to ensure assets are performant, scalable, and production-ready.

 - Rapidly prototype, iterate, and refine designs based on playtesting, feedback, and evolving product requirements.

 - Identify opportunities to improve existing UI and proactively raise the visual quality and usability of the game.

 - Help establish efficient workflows, processes, and best practices for UI art production.

 - Provide thoughtful feedback, and mentorship to other artists when appropriate.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 10+ years of professional UI, UX, or game art experience, with experience contributing to at least one commercially shipped game.

 - A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional UI design, visual design, iconography, and game interface work. A portfolio is required for consideration.

 - Strong fundamentals in visual design, composition, typography, color, hierarchy, iconography, and information design.

 - Experience taking UI concepts from rough exploration through polished, production-ready assets.

 - A strong understanding of UX principles and human-computer interaction, with the ability to balance usability and visual expression.

 - Experience designing for different screen sizes, resolutions, and aspect ratios.

 - Experience creating visual systems and maintaining consistency across a large number of UI elements and features.

 - Proficiency with industry-standard design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or equivalent.

 - Experience working directly in a game engine and understanding the practical requirements of implementing UI in a game.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly explain design decisions and incorporate feedback.

 - The ability to work independently, manage priorities, and make sound visual decisions in a fast-moving production environment.

 - A high level of craft and attention to detail, with a genuine passion for making games look and feel great.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT NECESSARY

 - Experience working on a card game, collectible card game, or strategy game.

 - Experience working on a live-service game with frequent content updates.

 - Experience shipping mobile games or games across multiple platforms.

 - Experience with motion design, UI animation, or interactive prototyping.

 - Experience with Unity or another game engine.

 - Familiarity with UI implementation, scripting, or programming.

 - Experience building or maintaining UI component libraries and design systems.

 - Experience providing mentorship or visual direction to other artists.

 - Experience working with Marvel, licensed IP, or other highly recognizable entertainment properties.

title: Product Manager
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Midjourney is an independent research lab exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species. We are a small, self-funded team focused on design, human infrastructure, and AI.

Most of the products we build don’t have obvious precedents. We need product managers who can help teams navigate that uncertainty, make decisions, and turn ambitious ideas into products people can actually use.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help lead that effort.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, and research throughout the product development process, using tools like Claude Code to prototype concepts. You’ll help teams stay organized, make thoughtful decisions, and move projects from early ideation to launch.

This is a hands-on role. Some days you’ll be writing product specs, running standups, and coordinating launches. Other days you’ll be interviewing users, reviewing prototypes, or digging into product questions that need deeper investigation. If you enjoy bringing structure to creative work and making it easier for great teams to do their best work, you’ll probably enjoy it here.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the execution of major product initiatives.

 - Partner closely with design and engineering from early exploration through launch.

 - Write product requirements, manage backlogs, and keep projects moving.

 - Facilitate planning, standups, reviews, and comms between teams.

 - Help teams make informed decisions through UXR, research, and using Midjourney deeply yourself.

 - Go deep on important product questions when needed, whether that means conducting user research, designing experiments, or working through a difficult product tradeoff.

 - Help teams decide what matters most and make smart choices about quality, scope, and speed.




YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You’ve spent the last several years building software people love to use.

 - You know how to create structure without weighing a team down.

 - You’re as comfortable writing a product spec as you are talking to users or reviewing a prototype.

 - You have a point of view, but care more about getting the product right than being right.

 - Using Claude Code and Cursor are part of your workflow.

 - You’re excited to build products that don’t come with established playbooks.

 - Work > ego




LOGISTICS

 - Full-time. SF Hybrid.

 - Compensation: $185,000-225,000 + benefits.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.



We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.



Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

 


THE ROLE:

As Airbyte's Accounting Manager, you’ll own the day-to-day of our accounting operations and reporting - and you’ll help us rebuild how that work gets done, replacing manual processes and outsourced accounting firm dependencies with clean, automated, in-house workflows.

We currently run a lean model with an outsourced accounting firm and a Senior Accountant. You’ll manage both, and over time help us bring accounting back in-house - taking ownership of more of the function as you go. You’ll report directly to the Director of Finance (who reports to the COO) as a thought partner on automating our close and operations, and you’ll have real room to experiment with modern tooling and AI to do it.

We're hiring someone with the intention of investing in their long-term growth. As the business evolves, this role is expected to take on increasing ownership and responsibility, with the opportunity to help shape and ultimately lead the accounting function over time. If you want to build a modern accounting function - not just maintain one - this is that seat.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own accounting operations and reporting - GL, AP/AR, and the general ledger close - with accuracy, timeliness, and US GAAP compliance; you’ll operate with high ownership and strong judgment.

 - Run the month-end close, and continuously shorten and automate it.

 - Manage a Senior Accountant and our outsourced accounting team, and help lead the transition of work in-house over time.

 - Prepare for and support external audits, including documentation, technical accounting memos, and internal controls.

 - Apply and help maintain technical accounting policies, including revenue recognition under ASC 606 and lease accounting under ASC 842.

 - Evaluate, implement, and optimize accounting systems and workflows - reducing manual work and building for scale.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Support to keep accounting accurate across our business systems.

 - Act as a thought partner to the Director of Finance on automating close and operations, including using AI where it drives real impact.

 - Grow into broader ownership of the accounting function as the business scales.

 - Perform and review detailed flux and variance analysis, identifying and proactively investigating unexpected trends or anomalies in our financials.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.

 - Ideally a Big 4 audit and startup combined background.

 - Working knowledge of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and lease accounting (ASC 842).

 - Strong systems instincts - you’ve evaluated, implemented, or redesigned accounting workflows and tools, and you reach for automation before manual effort.

 - Tech-savvy and genuinely AI-curious - you’ve explored (or are eager to explore) how automation and AI can transform accounting, and you like building.

 - An operational, ownership mindset - pragmatic, solution-oriented, and able to work autonomously. Startups move fast, so the ability to adapt and learn quickly is key.

 - A people person. We have a strong culture and care about bringing in teammates who fit in and make it better.

 


NICE TO HAVE:

 - CPA or CMA certification is a plus.

 - Experience implementing or migrating to a new ERP system.

 - Experience with PLG and/or enterprise SaaS revenue models.

 - Familiarity with our stack: NetSuite, Rillet, Campfire, Ramp, Carta, Orb, and Claude Code.

 - Experience with auditing.

 


LOCATION:

 - Onsite 4 days/week in San Francisco, CA




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

 - Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually

 - 12-16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

 - Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office

 - A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact



If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!



We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered.



Airbyte is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, familial status, domestic violence victim status, veteran or military status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.



Airbyte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodations due to a disability.

AI AT ZAPIER

 - You think in systems. You build mogrts files, component libraries, and motion guidelines that other people can use independently, and every project is an opportunity to make the next one ship faster

 - You understand brand as well as UI: timing, easing, personality, the emotional register that makes motion feel ownable rather than generic

 - You have a strong sense of sound and rhythm. You know how motion and sound work together, and you shape that relationship intentionally rather than as an afterthought

Things You’ll Do:

 - Create motion guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files that give partners and social teams repeatable building blocks to work from independently

 - Explore tools like Jitter and Figma Motion to enable partners to generate on-brand animated assets without Brand Studio involvement every time
