 - Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

 - Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

 - Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

 - Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

 - Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Demand generation at Gorgias is being rebuilt from the ground up. The demand gen function as it exists today is operations-heavy but campaign-light: we can build systems, but we haven't been running the multichannel campaigns a modern demand gen function runs. This hire is the marketer who changes that — someone who has done demand gen the traditional way, knows the fundamentals of every channel, and now layers AI on top for efficiency. You will be the first true campaign strategist on the team, and you'll help define the playbook rather than inherit one.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run paid media end to end across paid search, paid social, G2, and other paid advertising programs — strategy, execution, and optimization.

 - Build and maintain email nurture programs for our subscriber base, designed to move leads through the funnel to sales.

 - Own campaign strategy and execution across channels — taking positioning, messaging, and content from the product marketing team and turning it into campaign-ready programs that actually ship. Campaigns can't perform when they're not launched; your job is getting them out the door.

 - Drive conversion optimization on landing pages and forms, partnering with our web developer (who sits outside marketing) to improve conversion rates.

 - Own the lead-to-sales handoff: prep campaign leads for sales and equip sales on how to work them.

 - Build the demand math: help establish our pipeline targets — how many meetings, leads, and qualified leads we need to generate X pipeline — and track against them. This measurement doesn't exist today; you'll help create it.

 - Apply ABM principles (platform-agnostic — Demandbase, 6sense, or equivalent) across programs.

 - Use AI daily to streamline repetitive work and find efficiencies in campaign operations — as a power user, not a builder. Custom systems and automations are the GTM Ops team's job; yours is knowing what to ask for.

 - Feed the playbook: test, learn, and work with the hiring manager to turn what works into documented, repeatable processes.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–5+ years in demand gen, growth marketing, or digital marketing at B2B tech companies — the channel fundamentals are real.

 - Hands-on paid media experience across search and social, plus email marketing automation.

 - Genuine multichannel experience — running campaigns across channels yourself and collaborating with partner marketing, sales, and content teams.

 - A strategic campaign marketer, not a specialist: we don't want someone who has only ever run paid search inside a big company.

 - Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter in the day-to-day.

 - Builder mentality for a zero-to-one environment. This is the big one. There are no pre-existing processes here — we are building them. If you need a playbook handed to you, this isn't the role. If the idea of walking into a function that's being rebuilt from scratch energizes you, it is.

 - Resilient, direct, and unflappable. You'll have strong leadership above you, but you need to be able to operate independently when it counts.


NICE TO HAVE

 - HubSpot experience (we use it, and we'll teach you our instance either way).

 - Experience at a scrappy, high-growth, or chaotic-stage company where you had to figure things out without support teams around you.

 - Experience working with product marketing to convert positioning into campaign messaging.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A rare opportunity to build a demand gen function from zero with full ownership of campaign strategy, at one of the fastest-growing companies in e-commerce support.

 - A leadership team that wants to test, learn, and have fun doing it — while fixing what isn't working.


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Hiring manager call (Eric)

 2. Case study: channel optimization — given a sample dataset (market size, current conversion rates by channel), present a campaign framework for getting from here to there. Framework and pitch, not full campaign build.

 3. Panel with Eric and Matilda (product marketing) — including how you'd turn PMM output into campaign messaging

 4. Final leadership call with Heather

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

title: Motion Designer, Paid Social (Contract)
description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).



Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is a hands-on motion design role for someone who builds motion that stops the scroll on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. You’ll take our brand team’s polished motion and rework it into performance-native ad variants, and you’ll build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated text and captions, logo, product, and UI motion, the pieces that carry a hook when there’s no live footage.

This is a craft role with real creative latitude. You won’t be handed a finished board and told to render it. You’ll bring your own ideas for how motion can earn attention and drive a click, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your work quickly enough to act on them.

If you live in After Effects, think in hooks and hold rates as much as keyframes, and want your motion in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.



Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Rework the brand team’s motion into performance-native ad variants for Meta and TikTok.

 - Build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated captions, logo, product, and UI motion.

 - Design motion that carries the hook in the first second, especially where there’s no live footage.

 - Produce multiple iterations of winning concepts to feed continuous creative testing.

 - Adapt motion across formats and placements (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) for Stories, Reels, and Feed.

 - Bring original concepts and angles to the table, not just execute against a board.

 - Hold brand coherence while pushing what actually works for performance.

 - Turn performance signals into sharper motion, doubling down on what’s working.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - A strong portfolio of motion built for short-form video ads on Meta and/or TikTok, or comparable performance work.

 - Senior-level command of Adobe After Effects, plus Premiere for assembly and CapCut for fast cuts.

 - A real grasp of direct-response creative: hooks, angles, pacing, and why motion wins or loses, not just how it looks.

 - Proven ability to produce a high volume of variants at pace without dropping quality.

 - A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

 - Comfort extending an existing brand system while building net-new motion for performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

 - Comfort reading performance metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and adjusting creative accordingly.

 - Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma for prepping and adapting assets.

 - Comfort folding AI tools into a motion workflow to move faster.

 - A love of music and an eye for culture.




COMPENSATION

This is a contract role paying $70 to $90 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.




ADDITIONAL NOTES

title: Marketing Designer, Performance Creative (Contractor)
description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).



Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno is growing fast, and paid social creative is a major driver of that growth. The right person for this role takes Suno's brand identity and pushes it into performance creative that earns attention and converts – work that drives growth and brings the excitement of using Suno to everyone who sees it.

As Graphic Designer on the Performance Marketing team, you'll own the branded paid social creative pipeline: conceiving, producing, and iterating on work across branded static formats. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team, treating data and channel insights as creative inputs rather than afterthoughts. Over time, you'll help build the workflows and systems that let us scale without losing what makes Suno's creative distinctive. As the team grows, there's a path to managing other creative contributors.

 

Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Translate Suno's brand identity and creative DNA into paid social creative that drives growth across paid channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)

 - Own the full branded creative pipeline – concepting, producing, and iterating on branded static assets

 - Build and maintain a creative roadmap: what to make, what to test, what to push further, and what to move on from

 - Partner with the performance marketing team to use data and channel feedback as creative inputs, not just outputs

 - Use AI tools to extend creative output beyond what's manually possible – and help build the processes and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on-brand and up to Suno's standards

 - Develop workflows and production processes that scale creative output without diluting brand quality

 - Help shape how the next generation of creators discovers Suno – the creative you make is often their first impression




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 4-6 years in performance creative, paid social design, or growth-focused creative at a consumer tech, DTC, or growth-stage company

 - Expert graphic design skills: strong static design fundamentals and a sharp eye for details and consumer psychology

 - Portfolio of paid social work that demonstrates both craft and a performance orientation

 - Expert-level proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, etc.

 - Fluency in what makes paid social creative work: hooks, formats, platform conventions, and what drives meaningful iteration

 - Ability to internalize a brand's visual identity and push it into new formats without losing what makes it distinctive

 


COMPENSATION

$75 - $90 per hour

 


ADDITIONAL NOTES

20-40 hours per week



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Account Executive, Mid Market
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 


ABOUT ZAPIER

We’re on a mission to make automation work for everyone.

As the leader in easy automation, Zapier empowers businesses to automate workflows and move data across 7,000+ apps. We work with what you work with, across your apps and tech stack, so you can make magic happen.

We’re at an interesting inflection point at Zapier. Automation and AI are reshaping how businesses operate, and we’re right in the middle of it. We’re looking for someone who wants to help drive that innovation, not just someone who wants to hit a number.

The role: you’ll be selling Zapier’s AI Orchestration platform to companies with up to 1,000 employees, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close.

Most of your pipeline will come from you. Cold outreach, turning a warm signal into a real conversation, finding the deal before it finds you, that's the job, and we need people who are built for that part, not just willing to do it.

Zapier's Mid-Market motion is early. We need architects, not order-takers. You won't inherit a playbook. You'll help write it

There's more than one path to this role

Likely you’ve been a top performer in SaaS sales (or consistently exceeding in mid-market, and you’re ready to step up) and can run a deal end-to-end, including prospecting. However, if you have a track record of tackling hard problems, hands-on experience with AI tools (not just familiarity), put customers first, and have a drive to make things happen you may also be a great fit for our team.

Either way, what separates a good candidate from a great one is proactive ownership, the ability to navigate ambiguity, strong stakeholder communication, cross-functional collaboration, and a genuine hunger to learn fast.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You have 2-5 years of demonstrated success in selling horizontal SaaS solutions to multi-stakeholder or technical organizations across the mid-market levels, with a strong focus on automation, integrations, and enhancing tech stack efficiency.

 - Proven track record of success in closing software deals over and meeting or exceeding your sales quota

 - Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and tools like Zapier, with the ability to explain their importance in modern tech ecosystems.

 - Demonstrated ability to discuss IT concerns, including security, scalability, compliance, and performance, in a credible and knowledgeable manner.

 - Excellent communication skills both with customers and within an organization

 - Ability to develop and navigate senior-level relationships quickly and effectively

 - You thrive in a state of ambiguity and are motivated by strong personal drive

 - You use AI in your work today, not occasionally, but as part of how you operate at a high level. You can point to workflows you’ve built, how your approach has evolved through iteration, and the impact on quality, efficiency, and experience while intentionally  applying AI for the right outcomes, setting a high bar for outputs, and taking ownership of what ships.

AI Fluency Assessment https://ai-fluency-hub.vercel.app/

 - Take our 10 minute AI Fluency Assessment by clicking the link above. See how your skills stack up against our sales bar, get a personalized tier, and walk away with actionable next steps to level up your AI skills.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own mid-market accounts end-to-end: prospecting, discovery, negotiation, close, and expansion

 - Sell Zapier’s AI-powered automation platform to enterprises moving from manual workflows to orchestrated, AI-first operations

 - Show up in the field: build relationships at events, conferences, and executive briefings that go deeper than a LinkedIn connection

 - Build relationships across the org from the people doing the work up to the C-suite

 - Lead conversations that help customers think through the real business impact of automation, not just the product features

 - Quarterback complex deals across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product. You’re accountable for the outcome, not just your piece

 - Help shape how we go to market at the mid-market level; the team is small, fast, and building the motion from scratch


WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

This section exists to save everyone time.

 - You’re coming from a large enterprise org and need a defined territory, established SDR/BDR support, and fully built enablement to be successful

 - You measure success by activity volume over deal quality

 - You want to avoid ambiguity and prefer a structured, repeatable process handed to you

 - You can demo a product’s features, but can’t frame the ROI or build a business case from a customer’s pain

 - AI is something you’ll “get around to” rather than something you’re already using


WHY JOIN NOW

Zapier is profitable, has been around long enough to know what we’re doing, and is growing into a bigger opportunity in AI and automation. You’ll do real work where your contributions are visible and your impact is measurable. Our team is deeply curious and always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers' needs.

If breaking into AI is something you’re thinking about, there are very few companies where you’ll build with it the way you will here. We’ll take you from capable to transformative—and that’s increasingly a career-defining skill set.

We are a remote-first company. We believe the people who win in AI and automation aren’t just product experts; they synthesize information, build business cases, and move faster than the competition.


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Corporate Counsel, Commercial
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Legal Team at Mural is a collaborative and highly trusted partner, working cross-functionally across the entire company. With a culture of pragmatism, curiosity, and partnership, the team provides expertise across customer contracts, privacy, marketing, IP, employment law, and risk management. Their work is critical to enabling growth and protecting Mural’s reputation, ensuring that every decision aligns with both legal standards and business goals.

 


YOUR MISSION

You will report directly to the General Counsel. You will get to apply your contract drafting and negotiations skills as well as your broader legal and business acumen to supporting the GTM and product teams.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements: SaaS subscription agreements, MSAs, SOWs, RFPs and NDAs.

 - Serve as the primary legal point of contact for the Sales team, partnering directly with Account Executives and sales leadership throughout the deal cycle to structure terms, manage risk, and close deals efficiently.

 - Partner with Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, and Finance on pricing, discounting, and other revenue-sensitive deal terms.

 - Advise on data privacy and security terms in customer agreements, partnering with the Privacy and Security teams as needed.

 - Own and continuously refine contract templates, fallback positions, and negotiation playbooks to improve consistency, reduce turnaround time, and enable the sales team to self-serve on standard terms.

 - Negotiate and manage partner, reseller, and vendor/procurement agreements in support of GTM and business operations needs.

 - Support contract renewals, upsells, and amendments, and field post-signature questions on contract interpretation from Customer Success and Account Management.

 - Identify and help implement ways to streamline and scale the contracting process, including AI-assisted contract drafting and review. 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4+ years of experience negotiating and structuring commercial agreements, with a focus on SaaS/technology transactions (in-house and/or law firm experience considered)

 - JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state Bar in good standing.

 - Developed knowledge of core SaaS commercial concepts and working knowledge of data privacy frameworks.

 - Strong business judgment and comfort making pragmatic, risk-adjusted decisions independently and under time pressure.

 - Excellent communicator who can translate legal concepts for non-legal, business stakeholders and build trusted relationships with Sales and other GTM partners.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities and a high volume of concurrent matters.

 - Experience with AI-assisted contracting tools.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: QA Analyst
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Midjourney is an independent research lab exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species. We are a small, self-funded team focused on design, human infrastructure, and AI.

Most of the products we build don't have obvious precedents. We need a QA practice that helps us understand how they'll behave in the real world, identify problems early, and ship with confidence.

You'll work closely with product, design, and engineering throughout development, helping teams identify problems early and ship with confidence.

This isn't a role where you'll spend your days executing checklists. We expect you to think critically about how products behave, investigate difficult issues, improve how we test software, and go deep on the projects that matter most. If your favorite part of the job is making products noticeably better—and helping everyone around you build with more confidence—you'll probably enjoy it here.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner closely with product, design, and engineering throughout the development process.

 - Stay close to the work by leading testing efforts on our most important product initiatives.

 - Go deep on difficult problems—whether that's investigating a difficult bug, identifying edge cases, improving test coverage, or helping a team understand how a product behaves in the real world.

 - Design thoughtful test plans and identify issues before they reach users.

 - Help improve how we test software through better tooling, automation, and testing practices.

 - Reproduce issues, identify root causes, and verify fixes before release.


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You've spent the last several years testing software people actually use.

 - You enjoy understanding how products behave, not just whether they work.

 - You're as comfortable investigating a subtle bug as you are thinking through an entire user flow.

 - You work well with designers, engineers, and product managers.

 - You care about quality and believe the best testing happens throughout development, not just before a release.

 - Tools like Claude Code and Cursor are part of your workflow.

 - You're excited by products that don't have established playbooks.

 - Work > ego




LOGISTICS

 - Full-time.

 - SF or NY Hybrid.

 - Compensation: 100,000–$125,000 + benefits.




TO APPLY

A resume is required.

title: Production Manager (Arabic speaking)
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE 

Productions is the 'done for you' managed services wing of ElevenLabs made for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts to unlock human-edited dubs, audiobooks, and more in 15+ languages directly on the ElevenLabs platform.




HERE ARE A FEW RECENT PROJECTS PRODUCTIONS HAS HELPED BRING TO LIFE:

 - Dubbing for some of the world's biggest creators (DudePerfect, Lex Fridman, Andrew Huberman), media businesses (Headspace) and broadcasters (Mediaset)

 - Audiobook production for leading publishers and digital storytelling platforms

 - Voice creation, sound design, and other audio engineering services for ElevenLabs' largest customers

 - You can learn more about Productions here: https://elevenlabs.io/productions




AS A PRODUCTION MANAGER, YOU DRIVE THE SUCCESS OF PRODUCTIONS FOR ONE OR MULTIPLE LANGUAGE TEAMS, INCLUDING:

 - Onboarding and training linguists and other audio professionals (Producers) to use the ElevenLabs platform

 - Building quality control and monitoring systems for your language to ensure the dubs, audiobooks, and other content we deliver sound natural and professional-grade 

 - Working with the Productions product and engineering team to optimize our tools and processes for high-quality content creation

 - Define our editorial line and set our creative direction, such as style guides, voice casting, translation and adaptation principles




REQUIREMENTS

While we don’t require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees, the following will set you apart as a candidate for a Production Manager role:

 - Native speaker of or native-level knowledge of Arabic.

 - Experience building and/or running a production team inside a language service provider (LSP), localization agency, media company, or similar for one or multiple of the following:
   
   - Transcripts
   
   - Translations
   
   - Dubs
   
   - Audiobooks

 - Strong attention to detail: you should have keen eyes and ears in your native language and be capable of spotting even the smallest inconsistencies or mistakes that keep something from reading or sounding 100% natural.

 - Comfortable giving feedback: you will be responsible for the quality of content the team produces in your language and should feel comfortable setting and maintaining a high bar.

 - Bonus points for:
   
   - Familiarity with the ElevenLabs platform, including our transcript editor, Studio, and dubbing products
   
   - Native-level abilities in multiple non-English languages




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.




#LI-Remote

description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

 - Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

 - Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

 - Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.


THE TEAMS YOU COULD BE JOINING

Billing & Monetization Team owns the commercial foundations behind Gorgias pricing and billing—from pricing and entitlements to usage visibility and AI monetization—so the business can launch products and evolve pricing with accurate, trusted billing. (Team roadmap https://app.notion.com/p/2c61ae2178f580a8a26fdbd160f5e269)

Actions & Skills Team builds the reusable platform that helps AI Agent follow merchant procedures and take action through connected apps, while making those actions easier to discover and use across Gorgias products. (Actions platform vision https://app.notion.com/p/3031ae2178f580169bf8f7056f63a2b0)

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the AI-driven platform that powers automated e-commerce support and sales. This is a high-impact role where you will shape our architecture, performance, and observability strategy to ensure our systems remain scalable, reliable, and fast.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Architect and evolve our AI agent platform, ensuring scalability, resilience, and high availability.

 - Design and implement monitoring & observability strategies, using tools like Datadog, or Grafana to track performance and detect issues proactively.

 - Collaborate across teams to integrate AI-driven features into our customer support ecosystem.

 - Optimize system performance, resources usage, ensure fast processing, building cost-effective solutions

 - Contribute to strategic decision-making on system design, best practices, and long-term scalability.

 - Mentor junior engineers and help shape the engineering culture at Gorgias.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - 4+ years of experience building and maintaining scalable web applications.

 - Deep expertise in system design, microservices, cloud-native and event-driven architecture.

 - Strong experience in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud computing platform

 - Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools (Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).

 - Proven ownership over large-scale projects, from design to deployment.

 - Experience working in a cross-functional, product-focused team.

 


COMPANY BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - 🏖️ 5-week vacation

 - 🤕 Paid sick leave

 - 🧸 Paid parental leave

 - 💻 MacBook Pro

 - 🏥 We provide private health insurance

 - 🍽️ Monthly lunch stipend of $300 gross added to your salary

 - 💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to €700 (gross) to set up your workstation at home (added to your first pay-check as an onboarding bonus)

 - 📚 Get up to €1,500 of learning budget and a FitPass yearly membership. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness.

 - 🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year, we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias
By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy https://www.gorgias.com/legal/applicant-privacy-policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias
We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services
Field Marketing Manager, Healthcare / SLED
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

About the role

As our Field Marketing Manager for Healthcare / SLED, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for Healthcare and State, Local & Education (SLED) — responsible for pulling together people and resources to build a full GTM marketing motion that lands and expands some of the company’s largest, most critical named accounts in these verticals.

This role sits in the Public Sector organization. You’ll help support Public Sector overall, with a clear focus on Healthcare and SLED, and you’ll collaborate across adjacent verticals where motions overlap (including Life Sciences events).

We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with vertical sales and flawless execution of industry experiences for customer executives. If you are obsessed with driving pipeline from high-touch, standout programs and are a self-starter who thrives at the intersection of technical innovation, healthcare / public-sector narrative, and enterprise GTM, we want you.

This is a remote role with travel for industry programs and customer engagements.

What You’ll Do

Pipeline Architecture & Vertical Ownership

 - Own the Healthcare / SLED GTM: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan for Healthcare and SLED, and orchestrate core business partners into one motion aimed at must-win accounts.

 - Master the Land & Expand: Own the vertical pipeline target. Design and run the programs that help priority accounts land, expand, and adopt more of the platform, focused where the commercial opportunity is highest.

 - Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable in-person, virtual, and next-gen experiences — and the operational workflows that bring them to life.

 - Industry Narrative: Translate the Cursor (now part of SpaceXAI) mission into healthcare and SLED language — the problems these buyers already feel (clinical / payer / provider / state & education IT), the outcomes they are measured on, and why this platform is the answer. Partner with PMM and corporate marketing so the story stays sharp, consistent, and specific enough that a CIO, CMIO, or public-sector technology leader hears their world, not a generic AI pitch.

 - Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Healthcare and SLED sales. Lead planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze vertical pipeline trends, lock alignment on priority accounts, and maximize the impact of every motion. Know what you run as Vertical vs what you plug into Enterprise Field formats. Support broader Public Sector needs as needed.

Measurement & Operational Excellence

 - Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program — ideation, promotion, vendor management, onsite, and follow-up — going beyond day-of execution.

 - Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your vertical budget toward high-impact investments on critical accounts.

 - Feedback Loop: Serve as the eyes and ears of Healthcare and SLED. Feed Corporate and PMM real-time feedback on messaging resonance and competitive shifts.

Your DNA

 - The Healthcare Vertical Owner: You assemble Sales, PMM, Enterprise Field, FE/Solutions, and CS/ADM into one motion aimed at pipeline on the company’s largest accounts, not just events. 5–7+ years of healthcare marketing / GTM experience is required (provider, payer, health systems, health tech, or adjacent). You know how to sell into healthcare buying centers and can partner credibly with sales on complex, regulated accounts.

 - The Revenue Mindset: You care about pipeline and closed-won, not leads. You speak sales and will be held to a number.

 - The Gritty Optimizer: A self-starter who can build a program from a blank page and tighten it with the data.

 - Exceptional Communicator: Sharp and persuasive, whether it’s a personal invite to a CIO / CMIO or a QBR for leadership.

Technical & Tactical Toolkit

 - Field Presence: Ability to travel (~30%) to host industry programs, support Vertical Sales, and connect with customers in-market.

 - Event Craft: Experience producing high-end, white-glove executive experiences — including industry-flagship overlays (e.g. HIMSS / CHIME / HLTH-class motions) and 1:few vertical ABM — that stand out in a crowded market.

title: Events Manager, Event Technology and Registration
Specialist Solutions Architect, Billing
Marketing Manager, MENAT
Head of Revenue Operations
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Head of Revenue Operations, you will be the architect of ElevenLabs' commercial operating system - the planning, data, processes, systems, and AI-powered workflows that enable our GTM organization to scale revenue predictably and efficiently.

You’ll own the operational foundation across our entire revenue organization, spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success. You’ll work directly with GTM leadership to shape how we plan, measure, and execute our commercial strategy.

This is a high ownership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, systems, AI, and execution. You’ll have significant influence over how ElevenLabs scales its revenue organization and will build the infrastructure, operating model, and team required for the next stage of growth.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Own the commercial operating model across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success, ensuring the organization can scale revenue predictably and efficiently.

 - Partner with the CEO, CFO, and GTM leadership team on revenue strategy, annual planning, forecasting, organizational design, investment decisions, and long-range growth planning.

 - Lead territory design, segmentation, quota setting, capacity planning, headcount planning, and GTM productivity across Corporate, Mid-Market, Enterprise, Strategic, and Partnerships.

 - Establish the operating cadence for the GTM organization, including forecasting, pipeline reviews, business reviews, performance management, and executive reporting.

 - Build the data, analytics, and systems foundation that gives leadership a trusted view of pipeline, conversion, productivity, attainment, retention, expansion, and revenue efficiency.

 - Own the evolution of the GTM technology stack, including Salesforce, ensuring systems, data, processes, and workflows scale with the business.

 - Lead the AI transformation of Revenue Operations, using AI and automation to increase productivity, improve decision-making, eliminate manual work, and fundamentally rethink how GTM teams operate.

 - Partner across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Product, and Customer Success to create consistent processes, shared definitions, and strong commercial execution.

 - Drive continuous improvement across the revenue funnel, from pipeline generation and acquisition through expansion and renewal.

 - Build and lead a world-class RevOps organization, developing the talent, structure, and capabilities required for ElevenLabs’ next stage of growth.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 10+ years of Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or related GTM experience, including significant leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

 - Proven track record of scaling revenue organizations across multiple GTM motions and segments, including Enterprise, Strategic, Mid-Market, and Partnerships.

 - Deep expertise in revenue planning, forecasting, territory and capacity planning, sales processes, compensation, and GTM performance management.

 - Strong understanding of usage-based business models and the metrics that drive efficient growth, including pipeline generation, acquisition, expansion, retention, and revenue productivity.

 - Experience building scalable GTM systems, data infrastructure, and operating processes, with deep familiarity with Salesforce and modern GTM technology.

 - Demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to increase GTM productivity, improve decision-making, and fundamentally rethink how Revenue Operations operates.

 - Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and decisions for executive leadership.

 - Proven ability to partner with and influence senior executives across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, Legal, and Customer Success.

 - Exceptional leadership and organizational skills, with a track record of building and developing high-performing RevOps teams.

 - Strong business judgment, bias for action, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.




LOCATION

This role is remote across the US, with the option to work from our San Francisco or New York offices if preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Manager, Build Operations
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 

As Senior Manager, Build Operations, you lead the function that surfaces insight, accelerates delivery, and reduces operational drag for Zapier's engineering and product teams. Your core mission is closing the gaps in how work gets prioritized, decided, and run across Build — reducing financial exposure, unblocking build velocity, and establishing continuity in how operations run.

You'll manage a team of four and partner across the organization to drive adoption and alignment — restoring execution capacity on the work most critical to Finance and Build leadership, and building the visibility, operating rhythms, and enablement that help engineering and product move faster. As that operating picture matures, you'll extend it to go-to-market teams so every part of the company works from the same source of truth — one shared view, in consistent language — that levels the playing field and takes the guesswork out of what's shipping and when.

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

 - Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/


ABOUT YOU

- Has been the operational backbone of an engineering or product org — restored execution on stalled work, stood up operating rhythms, and earned the trust of senior technical leaders.

- Experience running cross-functional programs that span multiple teams or organizations, not just managing work within a single team

- Proven ability to translate technical or engineering concepts into language and frameworks that non-technical audiences can use and own

- Strong project and program management fundamentals: you're comfortable with project plans, milestones, dependency tracking, risk management, and change documentation

- Ability to partner across functions and influence without relying on title — you can hold a room and drive alignment in complex settings

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and fast-paced change; you thrive when scope isn't fully defined and you have to figure out the path

- Experience securing buy-in and resourcing from senior stakeholders on programs that weren't yet fully scoped or understood

- Familiarity with modern operations tools and the willingness to microlearn new systems; deep technical expertise is not required

- Experience embedding AI into team workflows and processes, not just using it for personal productivity


THINGS YOU’LL DO

- Restore execution capacity on the P0 workstreams blocking Finance and Build leadership — take ownership, drive them to completion, keep them current.

- Provide the operational layer the Build Org needs to execute strategy, and drive the prioritized work already published.

- Design and socialize the operating model Build runs on — turning engineering-side architecture and rhythms into something teams actually adopt — and extend that shared framework to go-to-market so both organizations operate the same way.

- Build, own, and scale the connected visibility layer — a live, auto-generated view of what's shipping, where work overlaps, and where ownership is at risk — starting in Build and extending across the business so every team works from one source of truth, in one language.

- Own the dependency and primitive-ownership routing layer so cross-team requirements reach the accountable owner instead of dying in DMs.

- Drive adoption through enablement — training, feedback loops, and continuous-improvement cycles — so change lands once, centrally, with adoption as a clear metric.

- Partner with Build and GTM leadership to spot adoption gaps, clear blockers, and secure resourcing for the initiatives that matter most.

- Build trust and durable relationships with Build's senior leaders; be the operational partner they rely on.

- Secure headcount, stabilize the team, and shore up the platforms the org depends on.

- Manage a team of four (an L4 TPM, two ops ICs, and a contractor); set direction and unblock their work.

- Document operational decisions and trade-offs; write the proposals that win senior alignment and resourcing.

- Identify and implement AI-powered tools and workflows to increase team efficiency and reduce manual overhead


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Senior Open-Source Python Engineer, ML Developer Tools - EMEA Remote
description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 11 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million Gradio apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Roles at Hugging Face are very fluid and dynamic — we are looking for someone who is comfortable taking on different challenges that will evolve over time.

You'll join the Applications team, whose goal is to build the tooling that helps developers create machine learning applications on top of the primitives we offer on the Hub: Gradio, Spaces, Inference Providers, Datasets, Xet, and more. Concretely, that means maintaining and growing libraries like Trackio, a local-first, agent-friendly experiment tracking platform, FastRTC, our library for real-time audio and video streaming in Python, and Gradio itself, used by more than 1 million developers each month. These tools have made machine learning accessible to a wide audience — for the first time in history, anyone with an internet connection can use cutting-edge models right from their browser.

Several of these libraries are still early in their life, and new ones will start from scratch. A large part of this role is taking a project from its first users to widespread adoption: shaping the API, shipping fast, and getting it into developers' hands.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining core features across the team's libraries, ensuring scalability, reliability, and ease of use for ML developers.
  • Architecting complex Python projects and frameworks that serve as foundational tools for the ML community.
  • Growing early-stage libraries: defining the API surface, writing the demos and documentation that make them click, and driving adoption in the developer community.
  • Working on real-time streaming and networking capabilities, a core priority for Gradio 7 and beyond.
  • Collaborating with open-source contributors and engaging with the broader community through code reviews, discussions, and support.
  • Integrating modern frontend technologies to create seamless and intuitive user experiences for Python-based web applications.
  • Adapting to evolving engineering challenges and contributing to the direction of our developer tools as the landscape changes.

Requirements

If you love open-source, are passionate about making machine learning more accessible, have experience building Python frameworks, and want to contribute to some of the fastest-growing libraries in the ML ecosystem, then we can't wait to see your application!

What you'll need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional Python development experience
  • Experience architecting complex Python projects or frameworks
  • A track record of taking early-stage libraries or products from first users to broad adoption
  • Professional experience with JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Professional experience with a modern frontend framework such as React or Svelte
  • Experience core-contributing to or maintaining open-source software projects

Nice to have

  • Experience with real-time audio/video streaming or networking (WebRTC, WebSockets)
  • Contributions to libraries such as pipecat, LiveKit, FastAPI, or Starlette

If you're interested in joining us, but don't tick every box above, we still encourage you to apply! We're building a diverse team whose skills, experiences, and backgrounds complement one another. We're happy to consider where you might be able to make the biggest impact.

One more thing

At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no catch, it just tells us a real person is on the other side.

Benefits

More about Hugging Face

We are actively working to build a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusivity. We are intentionally building a workplace where people feel respected and supported—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We believe this is foundational to building a great company and community. Hugging Face is an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We value development. You will work with some of the smartest people in our industry. We are an organization that has a bias for impact and is always challenging ourselves to continuously grow. We provide all employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education.

We care about your well-being. We offer flexible working hours and remote options. We offer health, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents. We also offer parental leave and flexible paid time off.

We support our employees wherever they are. While we have office spaces in NYC and Paris, we're very distributed and all remote employees have the opportunity to visit our offices. If needed, we'll also outfit your workstation to ensure you succeed.

We want our teammates to be shareholders. All employees have company equity as part of their compensation package. If we succeed in becoming a category-defining platform in machine learning and artificial intelligence, everyone enjoys the upside.

We support the community. We believe major scientific advancements are the result of collaboration across the field. Join a community supporting the ML/AI community.

title: Account Manager, Commercial
description:
