title: Engineering Manager - Social
description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Engineering Manager to lead Suno’s Social team — a small, high-caliber group of fullstack product engineers building the network effects that turn Suno from a single-player creation tool into a creative network. You’ll own the team’s talent, delivery, and technical direction across the social layer: organic notifications, profiles and creative identity, the follow graph, and social engagement from sharing to comments. This is a hands-on leadership role — you’ll grow the team, set the technical bar by example, and partner closely with product, design, and data science to discover what social means for music. The charter is still expanding (sharing is next), so you’ll help shape where it goes, not just execute a fixed roadmap.



Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/GsrerPlrPvDQymS8




WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Lead a small team of fullstack product engineers who own Suno’s social layer — notifications, profiles, the follow graph, and social engagement from sharing to comments

 - Grow the team by hiring strong engineers, developing them across the stack, and holding a high bar through honest, firm performance management

 - Set technical direction for social systems at scale — guiding architecture for the follow graph, notifications, and profiles, and championing mobile-first API design

 - Partner with product, design, and data science on roadmap ideation, discovering and fostering the emergent social behaviors that deepen engagement

 - Ship retention-driving features with end-to-end rigor: metrics read-outs, logging, dogfooding, and post-launch follow-up

 - Advance Suno’s mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality by building the network that lets people create and experience music together





WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Must-Haves

 - 5–7 years in software engineering, including 2–4 years managing engineers — hiring, developing, and running firm performance cycles

 - Genuine, demonstrable intuition for social products and network effects — you’re a real user and a first-principles thinker about what makes products sticky, and you understand how to grow a network without collapsing context

 - Enough technical depth to guide architecture and stay hands-on — you can review code, weigh trade-offs, and jump into the codebase when it helps

 - A track record of creating structure in ambiguous, 0→1 environments, ideally shipping consumer social products at startup pace

 - Strong asynchronous, cross-functional communicator who reduces ambiguity rather than creating it

 - A love of music (listening, exploring, making — we’re not picky about genre)

Nice-to-Haves

 - Experience on a growth team — social and growth are two sides of the same coin

 - Founding or 0→1 experience inside a larger organization (a “startup within a startup”)

 - Fullstack range across mobile, web, and backend

 - Familiarity with network-effects and engagement-mechanics literature




PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)



Additional Notes:

 - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 - This role requires working onsite at our NYC office.



Compensation:

 - The annual salary range for this role is $277K - $346K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

title: Engineering Manager, ChatGPT Search Infrastructure
description:
About the Team

The ChatGPT Search Infrastructure team builds the foundational systems that power search experiences across ChatGPT. We develop the infrastructure that connects models with search systems and other sources of real-time information, enabling ChatGPT to deliver timely, relevant, and trustworthy answers to users around the world.

Our work sits at the intersection of product engineering, AI, and large-scale infrastructure. We build shared platforms and abstractions that enable product teams to independently develop, evaluate, and launch new search-powered experiences. These platforms provide the guardrails, testing capabilities, observability, and rollout controls needed to prevent reliability, scalability, quality, and latency regressions while supporting rapid product iteration.

The team partners closely with:

 - Post-Training on model launches, experimentation, and prompt optimization

 - Search product verticals on new user experiences

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for ChatGPT’s Search Infrastructure.

You will set the technical and organizational direction for the systems that bring search capabilities into ChatGPT. You will balance immediate launch and product needs with the long-term reliability, scalability, latency, and maintainability of the platform.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


AS A MANAGER OF SECURITY ENGINEERING, YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

 - Serve as trusted advisor to team’s leadership and partner teams by clearly articulating business risks associated with security issues

 - Execute the long-term vision for the Security team in alignment with Cohere’s product and business goals.

 - Collaborate closely with leadership to prioritize high-impact initiatives and strategic customer engagements.

 - Vulnerability Management: Develop and implement enterprise-wide vulnerability management processes and tooling, including identification, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting, including customer artifacts

 - Static Application Security Testing (SAST): Establish SAST programs, integrate tools into CI/CD pipelines, and analyze results to identify and remediate security flaws in source code

 - Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST): Implement DAST methodologies, configure scanning tools, and conduct regular assessments of running applications

 - Penetration Testing: Lead and oversee internal and external penetration testing engagements, including web application, API, network and agentic AI platform including managing our bug bounty program

 - Security Architecture Review: Collaborate with development teams to review and validate security architecture and design patterns

 - Secure SDLC Integration: Embed security practices throughout the software development lifecycle, working closely with engineering and product teams

 - Team Leadership: Lead and grow a high-performing team of Security engineers through hiring, coaching, and mentorship

 - Metrics and Reporting: Establish key security metrics, generate regular reports for leadership, and communicate security posture to stakeholders

 - Compliance and Standards: Ensure application security practices align with industry standards (OWASP Top10 for LLMs, ISO 27001) and regulatory requirements

 - You have 8+ years of previous experience in Application Security / Security Engineering with a strong focus on vulnerability management, SDLC and bug bounty programs.

 - Proven experience with SAST, DAST, and penetration testing methodologies and tools

 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security

 - You understand secure engineering best practices, can articulate problem statements, and propose solutions to both technically savvy and non-technical audiences.

Remote US or Canada

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Artists & Creators
description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno is standing up an Artists & Creators pod, and our first major focus is Songkick.com http://Songkick.com — our newly acquired live music and ticketing product. We're hiring an early team to take technical ownership of Songkick within Suno across the stack: the backend, the website, the mobile app, the data pipelines, and the notification systems that power it. You'll report to the Songkick Engineering Manager and work closely with the Songkick General Manager, our Product Manager, and our Music teams to help define how this team tracks success and grows. Early on, the work is hands-on and diverse — understanding the existing system deeply, stabilizing it, and finding the integration points that make Songkick and Suno stronger together. Over time, this role has real influence over the roadmap, engineering best practices, and leaving a handprint on Suno's Artists & Creators engineering team.



Check out the Suno version of the role here! https://suno.com/s/emzEA5oPeNN6dxK2




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own part of the Songkick product end-to-end, wherever you’re strongest — from backend, mobile app (React Native, iOS + Android), data pipelines, and notifications

 - Lead the technical integration of Songkick into Suno, partnering with the Songkick Engineering Manager, Product Manager, incoming General Manager, and our existing engineering team to identify what to build next

 - Architect and maintain data aggregation systems that ingest, normalize, and score touring and event data from dozens of sources into a single canonical record

 - Assess a large, established codebase and make clear-eyed calls about what to preserve, modernize, or retire

 - Design APIs consumed by mobile clients, working directly with the teams building on top of them

 - Extend Suno's mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality into how fans discover and experience live music




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Must-Haves

 - 5–10 years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated hunger to stay close to the code and the end user

 - An ownership mentality — you enjoy taking a large, ambiguous product space and running with it end-to-end

 - Startup experience shipping quickly in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

 - Strong API design skills, having worked closely with iOS/Android or other mobile teams

 - A flexible set of communication styles — you reduce entropy rather than create it, pride yourself on your ability to write, as well as facilitate live discussions with stakeholders ranging in level of technical expertise

 - Experience working with modern agentic coding workflows, including E2E testing harnesses, reusable skills, and defining clear success criteria

 - Enthusiasm for rapid learning, regardless of whether technology and tools are brand new or legacy

 - A preference for deeply collaborative environments

Experience with a few of the following:

 - Experience building systems that ingest data from 20+ sources, normalize it, score or weight it by source reliability, apply survivorship rules, and store a canonical record

 - Strong SQL and NoSQL experience

 - Strong data modeling and system architecture skills at scale

 - Tuning Web, Android, and/or iOS performance metrics with a healthy fear of red numbers

 - Building out a design system to accelerate development whilst keeping a consistent feel

 - Experience retrofitting design systems

Nice-to-Haves

 - Hands-on experience with React Native and/or Ruby on Rails

 - Experience building or maintaining email or push notification systems

This Role is a Match for Candidates Who:

 - Thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments — you don't need everything mapped out to move forward

 - Bring low ego and high versatility, equally at ease debugging a small fix or driving a major project

 - Get energy from rapid prototyping and iteration — you'd rather ship something rough and refine it than wait for perfect

 - Have a genuine passion for music and live events, and want that passion reflected in your work
   
   


ADDITIONAL NOTES:

title: Senior Research Engineer - Safety Tooling and Data
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Role Overview:

As a Senior Research Engineer in our Safety team, you will play a key role in helping develop safer, more secure, and more reliable models. Your primary focus will be on building tools to enable easy data synthesis, analysis, and management, for complex combinations of real and synthetic data that is used in both model training and evaluation. You will own the cohesive vision of these tooling repositories.

You will work closely with a team of research scientists and engineers to create tooling that enables tighter experimentation cycles, better data coverage of the real world, and more scientific rigour. You will have a lot of autonomy and need to be opinionated about what areas of the codebase need elegance and standards, and where that would be overengineering. You will be given high level experimental problems that need to be solved with efficient pipelines, and design and implement the solutions. Your data analysis will collaboratively feed into modelling decisions and experimentation.

This role combines expertise in software engineering, statistics, and data science. If any of these topics sound interesting to you, we encourage you to apply.

You will be working on the Modelling Safety and Trust team, so interest in these areas is a plus, but is not at all required.

Please Note: We have offices in London, Edinburgh, Paris, Toronto, Montreal and New York, but we also embrace being remote-friendly! This role has timezone restrictions (UK, Europe, or ET) but no location restrictions.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Design and implement robust data pipeline tooling that enables frequent, low-friction data generation and annotation

 - Create cohesive data infrastructure that supports continuous parallel operation with model experimentation

 - Establish standardized processes for data validation, analysis, and improvement of data both training and evaluation

 - Collaborate with the ML modeling team to align data capabilities with experimental needs

 - Maintain opinionated, well-documented solutions that become team standards

 - Develop systematic analysis frameworks to identify incoming data sources and benchmark coverage gaps



Qualifications:

 - Extremely strong software engineering skills.

 - Strong statistical skills and experience evaluating scientific experiments related to data collection and model performance.

 - Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and Big Data Analytics (e.g. BigQuery, SQL)

 - Demonstrated ability to own complex technical projects from conception to deployment

 - Opinionated approach to technical architecture with ability to make principled decisions

 - Understanding of ML data requirements and the intersection of data engineering with modeling workflows



Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

 




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

description:

You will design and implement the fundamental transformations infrastructure—Stateful Stream Processing Engines, Incremental View Maintenance Engine, Materialization Internals, and the Distributed Orchestration Fabric. Our solid foundation supporting the seamless transition for enterprises between batch and streaming through Dynamic Tables, Streams & Tasks, and DBT Projects is the starting point. Your architectural work will extend the reach of the core engine to accelerate and support the massive scale of the Snowpark and Spark ecosystems. You are building the systems that allow both data engineers and autonomous agents to process exabytes of data with sub-second state propagation and absolute transactional integrity across the Snowflake Data Cloud.

As a Principal Engineer II, you will own the technical vision for the Data Transformation umbrella of capabilities. Your work on streaming internals and declarative state management provides the architectural substrate for high-performance customer features processing. This foundational technology is engineered to drive low-latency, high-throughput data transformations at a massive scale to empower enterprises to build and scale complex applications, including autonomous agentic loops. This infrastructure enables our broader ecosystem to operate on live, governed data, ensuring that the core engine primitives we build translate directly into superior data freshness and processing efficiency for every customer.

 - Drive Technical Strategy for the AI Era: Provide technical leadership to senior management and multiple departments, influencing how Snowflake’s core compute fabric evolves to support the burgeoning Model Context Protocol (MCP), autonomous agent ecosystems and modern Python and Spark data processing workflows.

 - Drive Customer Success through Direct Engagement: Partner with Snowflake’s most strategic customers and field engineering teams to translate massive-scale architectural challenges into core engine requirements, ensuring our processing primitives meet the real-world demands of the global Data Cloud.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER II WILL HAVE:

description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Senior Compensation  to support our mission.

This role is based in San Francisco or NYC and open to those who are able to be in-office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.



About the Team

The People Team at Patreon is focused on building an environment where our people and our business can do their best work. We partner closely with leaders and teams across the company to attract, develop, reward, and retain exceptional talent while creating thoughtful, scalable programs that support Patreon as we grow and evolve. We’re a collaborative, pragmatic team that cares deeply about the employee experience and isn’t afraid to rethink how we work to better serve our people and the business.



About the Role

Key Responsibilities:

 - Compensation Strategy Development: Lead the development and execution of Patreon’s compensation strategy, aligning it with the company’s objectives and market trends. Regularly assess and adjust compensation structures to attract, motivate, and retain high-performing employees.

 - Market Research and Benchmarking: Manage the benchmarking review process by conducting thorough market analysis to understand industry compensation trends, both domestically and internationally. Utilize benchmarking data to ensure Patreon’s compensation remains competitive and compelling.

 - Total Rewards Enhancement: Collaborate with HR, leadership, and benefits team to design and enhance Patreon’s total rewards framework, including base salary, variable pay, equity programs, and benefits, to ensure a comprehensive and appealing package for employees.

 - Equity Program Management: Oversee Patreon’s equity program design, including stock options and other equity-based incentives. Manage equity pool and spend. Educate employees on equity programs and support them in understanding the long-term value.

 - Compensation Planning and Review Cycles: Manage various compensation planning processes, including the annual review cycle, mid-year review, pay equity analysis, and  bonus payouts. Ensure a fair and transparent process that aligns with budgetary guidelines.

 - Compensation Surveys and Tools: Ensure the data and tooling used at Patreon are the most accurate, relevant, and up to date.

 - Data Analysis and Insights: Leverage data and analytics to provide insights on compensation trends, cost projections, and potential areas for improvement. Develop reports and dashboards to communicate compensation-related metrics to leadership.

 - Collaboration and Partnerships: Collaborate closely with PBPs, Finance, Legal, and Talent Acquisition teams to ensure seamless execution of compensation programs. Provide guidance on compensation-related matters to enable effective decision-making.

 - Compliance and Governance: Stay up-to-date with relevant labor laws and regulations to ensure that Patreon’s compensation programs remain compliant. Maintain accurate documentation of compensation-related policies and practices.

 - Deep understanding of compensation theories, methodologies, and best practices.

 - Experience with equity program management.

 - Strong analytical skills, including proficiency in data analysis and utilization of compensation survey data.

 - Exceptional communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.

 - Extremely data driven, thorough, and meticulous.

 - Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing compensation strategies aligned with business goals.

 - Knowledge of relevant labor laws and regulations related to compensation.

description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is bringing its AI platform to the U.S. federal government — defense and civilian agencies whose legal, acquisition, and program teams are asking how to adopt AI responsibly. You will be Harvey's first Solutions Architect dedicated to public sector: the technical lead on federal opportunities, the person who designs how Harvey is deployed securely inside government environments, and the one who writes the playbook the rest of the team will follow.

You will sit at the intersection of Harvey's platform, agency stakeholders (legal, IT, security, acquisition, and program offices), and our Security & Trust, Legal Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams. This is an opportunity to help define how AI is adopted across the federal government and to build a flagship public-sector practice at one of the fastest-moving companies in applied AI.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead technical discovery and solution design for federal prospects and customers — defense and civilian — working with legal, IT, security, acquisition, and program stakeholders.

 - Design, document, and defend secure, compliant architectures for Harvey in government environments, including Harvey's FedRAMP High environment, identity and access patterns, integrations, and data-handling requirements (CUI, records retention, auditability).

 - Own the technical thread on a focused portfolio of high-impact federal accounts, from first conversation through rollout, adoption, and expansion.

 - Be the field-facing technical partner to Security & Trust on agency security reviews — FedRAMP High controls, DoD Impact Levels, ATO and authorization boundaries, NIST 800-53 — and translate them for program owners and counsel.

 - Work with Legal Engineers and Customer Success Managers to turn agency workflows and legal or policy use cases into concrete solutions, reusable patterns, and implementation playbooks.

 - Be the public-sector technical voice back into Harvey, synthesizing field feedback to inform roadmap, evaluation criteria, deployment options, and government-specific documentation.

 - Represent Harvey's technical perspective in public-sector forums — customer workshops, working groups, and stakeholder briefings — helping agencies understand both the possibilities and the limits of current AI systems.

 - Build the public-sector Solutions Architecture playbook — qualification, security review, deployment patterns, and enablement — so the practice can scale beyond one person.



WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 7+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

 - Direct experience selling to or supporting U.S. federal customers (Department of Defense and/or civilian agencies) at a SaaS or cloud provider, including navigating agency security reviews and procurement.

 - Working knowledge of federal compliance frameworks and how they shape deployment — FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, DoD Impact Levels, ATO processes — and the ability to explain them to CISOs and program managers alike.

 - Hands-on depth in SaaS security and identity architecture: SSO/SAML, SCIM, encryption and key management, data residency, audit logging.

 - Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences — from program managers and attorneys to CISOs and enterprise architects — and credibility with senior public-sector stakeholders.

 - Hands-on engagement with modern AI systems (LLMs, prompt design, evaluation, deployment patterns) and a desire to help agencies adopt them responsibly.

 - Comfort operating in an emerging practice area: energized by ambiguity, willing to build new playbooks, motivated by real-world impact on public services.


PREFERRED

 - Prior government service or military experience.

 - Experience with Azure Government or other government cloud environments.

 - Experience selling through federal systems integrators or contract vehicles.

 - Background in legal, e-discovery, or other document-heavy enterprise workflows.



COMPENSATION

$218,800 - $300,900 USD OTE with a 80/20 split 




LOCATION

Remote within Washington, DC area - travel approximately 25–40% to agency and partner sites.

title: Sr. Director, GTM Process & Operations
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


THE POSITION



Snowflake is seeking a Sr. Director, GTM Process & Operations to own our global GTM operating model, reporting to the SVP of Revenue Strategy and Operations. This executive role defines how Snowflake's revenue motion runs — setting business priorities and processes, leading AI and automation adoption across GTM workflows, and standardizing the Quote-to-Cash and field support functions that directly drive revenue velocity. You will own the operating cadence that connects GTM strategy to execution, lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Partner Operations, and manage a global team of Directors, Senior Managers, and specialists across QTC, Core Sales, and Shared Services.



As a key leader in Snowflake's AI-native RevOps evolution, you will inherit a highly capable team and push it further — ensuring Snowflake's own revenue operations are the best proof point for Snowflake's technology.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



GTM Business Strategy & Operating Model
Own GTM business priorities, processes, policies, and operating metrics across the revenue motion. Define field requirements and translate GTM strategy into clear business cases and outcome targets. Drive the operating cadence that connects strategy to execution.

AI & Automation Adoption
Lead GTM's adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows within business processes. Build and test AI solutions in the context of GTM operations — own adoption rates and business results. Partner with ET for the platforms, security, controls, integration, and production support that make those solutions reliable and scalable.

Revenue Velocity
Standardize global sales workflows and streamline Quote-to-Cash to reduce cycle times and field friction. Own the business process layer; partner with ET to ensure the underlying data and systems are fast, reliable, and trusted enough for field leaders to act on without verification overhead.

Field Support
Provide strategic leadership for the Field Support organization, integrating specialized deal support with centralized operational execution to optimize field productivity and customer success.

Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with ET, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Partner Operations to scope GTM capabilities and define investment priorities. Provide clear business requirements and outcomes accountability; partner with ET for architecture, technical standards, and delivery. Avoid creating duplicate decision rights or additional translation layers between the business and technology.

Team Leadership
Manage and grow a global team of Directors, Senior Managers, and specialists across QTC, Core Sales, and Shared Services. Build a product-led culture — one where your team works directly with business users, understands their problems deeply, and drives adoption without requiring intermediary layers.

Snowflake on Snowflake
Serve as the business partner and proving ground for Snowflake's own AI and data capabilities. Represent GTM requirements and adoption outcomes; partner with ET, Product, and Data Engineering — who lead the technology work — to embed Snowflake's capabilities into internal GTM workflows.

 
 


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 15+ years of professional experience, with 8+ years leading Sales Operations, GTM Operations, or Revenue Strategy functions in a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment

 - Proven success managing global, multi-layered teams across process design, field enablement, and SLA-driven shared services operations

 - Deep expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (SFDC, CPQ, CLM) and how it supports GTM business processes

 - Experience defining business requirements and outcome metrics that drive technology investment decisions in partnership with IT or Engineering counterparts

 - Demonstrated ability to drive executive alignment through data, manage competing priorities, and communicate across technical and business audiences

 
 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience leading a GTM operations team through an AI adoption transition — owning field adoption, business results, and use case validation, with technology delivery handled by a partner organization

 - Track record of working directly with business users without intermediary layers — building credibility as both a domain expert and an operational partner

 - Demonstrated ownership of operating metrics, field productivity programs, or a GTM transformation initiative where business outcomes were the primary measure of success

 - Experience translating ambiguous GTM strategy into structured requirements that a technical team can architect and deliver against

 - Executive presence and credibility with peer VPs and SVPs — able to represent the business clearly and hold the line on requirements without drifting into technology ownership
   
   Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

You'll design these systems, write the code, run them in production, and own the results. Agentic systems make this harder than it is at a typical SaaS company: when an AI agent acts on a user's behalf against their most sensitive documents, protecting data, credentials, and execution boundaries becomes essential to every workflow.

Security at Harvey is an engineering discipline, not a gatekeeper function.
